page.overview:
Who is Actor 2?

Actor 2 is a stage actor in Charles Montgomery Burns' "playroom". He acts in a play alongside Actor 1 despite a lack of audience. Burns berates the actors, saying that the particular play they were performing was supposed to have closed the week before.
